sources.title: BLOOM (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The BigScience Large Open-science Open-access Multilingual Language Model (BLOOM) is an open-access large language model (LLM) released in 2022. [1] It was created by a volunteer-driven research effort to provide a transparently-created alternative to proprietary AI models.

sources.title: bloom-560m: Self-Hosting & Deployment Guide - LLM API
sources.snippet: What is bloom-560m? bloom-560m is an open-weight text generation model, published by bigscience with open weights at bigscience/bloom-560m. LLM API does not route this model today, so there is no endpoint or code sample for it here.
